description: Get recently launched tokens from recognized memecoin launchpads, screened by age, liquidity, volume, and transactions. Generic new DEX pairs are excluded; response includes complete/partial chain coverage.

chains.description: Comma-separated chain IDs. Default `solana,bsc`: the chains with a recognised meme launchpad (Pump.fun on Solana; Four.meme and Flap on BNB Chain). Other chains are scanned but return no rows until a launchpad signal exists for them.

days.description: Launch lookback window in days, from 1 to 30.

limit.description: Maximum launch rows to return, from 1 to 200.

profile.description: Screening profile for liquidity, volume, and transaction thresholds.

name: get_memecoin_launches

ageHours.description: Hours since the token's first DexScreener pair (ageBasis token), or since this pair was created when that lookup failed (ageBasis pair). For a migrated Pump.fun token (migrationState migrated) the first pair is its PumpSwap migration pool, so this is the time since migration, not since the mint.

holdersCount.description: Always null: the launch scan runs no holder lookup. Read the token's holders from the Rug Check endpoints.

launchedAt.description: When the token's first DEX pool opened. Null when migrationState is migrated (that pool is the migration; the mint time is not known to the scan) or the age is unknown.

migrationState.description: migrated: a Pump.fun mint (address ending in pump) trading on PumpSwap, where graduates migrate. unknown: a Pump.fun or Sun Pump token with no migration evidence. Null for other launchpads.

pairUrl.description: DexScreener pair URL; may be empty when launchpad identity is inferred from dexId.

return1h.description: 1-hour price return, as a fraction (0.125 is +12.5%); null when the hour had no trades.

return24h.description: 24-hour price return, as a fraction (0.125 is +12.5%); null when the day had no trades.

riskFlags.description: low_liquidity (under $10K), low_activity (under 20 trades in 24h), high_volume_liquidity_ratio (24h volume over 25x liquidity), copycat_ticker (a launchpad token under a major's ticker, e.g. BNB or ETH).

securitySignalSource.description: Always null: no security scan runs on the launch feed (riskFlags is a liquidity and activity screen). Check a token with the Rug Check endpoints.

meta.description: Which route answered, what the API said about the data's freshness, and whether the client cut the answer to fit the agent's context window.

route.description: Always `v1`: every call reads the keyed /v1 route.

truncated.description: True when the answer is cut short: by the API's row budget, or by the client (`truncated_fields`).

truncated_fields.description: The arrays and strings the client cut, by JSON path in `data`: `total` items received, `showing` kept, `kept: latest` when an oldest-first series kept its newest items.

warnings.description: What the API or the client could not do, in words. State them with the answer.

pagination.description: Present when the answer is one page: pass `cursor` back to read the next one.

title: Memecoin launches
